{{Quote|I am sending you to the Mustafar system in the Outer Rim. It is a volcanic planet. You will be safe there.|General Grievous to the Separatist Council|<ref name="RotS">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Mustafar''' was a small, young [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]] of the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Orbiting the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Priate/Legends|Priate]], the planet was situated between the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Jestefad/Legends|Jestefad]] and [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]], the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] from the two worlds tearing Mustafar apart and causing its unstable geology, despite it having once been a lush world orbiting Jestefad. The world experienced rains of ash, and its surface was covered in volcanoes, [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]], and lava rivers. The [[Atmosphere/Legends|skies]] above Mustafar contained ash, smoke, and bits of rock and glass, and cyclonic updrafts and thermal currents caused turbulence. Though the catastrophe that turned the planet hellish had [[Death/Legends|wiped out]] all life above ground, Mustafar was the harshest environment known to have still allowed for the evolution of native lifeforms. The celestial body was [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] to the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]], themselves split into the [[Southern Mustafarian/Legends|Southern]] and [[Northern Mustafarian/Legends|Northern Mustafarian]] [[Species/Legends|sub-species]], as well as the [[Lava flea/Legends|lava fleas]], [[Sher Kar/Legends|Sher Kars]], [[Jawenko lava beast]]s, [[tanray]]s, [[Kubaza beetle/Legends|kubaza beetles]], [[Jundak/Legends|jundaks]], [[Xandank/Legends|xandanks]], and [[Blistmok/Legends|blistmoks]].

Around [[5300 BBY]], Mustafar was the location of a [[Jedi enclave (Mustafar)/Legends|Jedi Enclave]] that was home to [[Jedi Master]] [[Chu-Gon Dar]], who created a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] artifact called the [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]]. Roughly 1,300 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] later, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi]] discovered a [[Lava crystal/Legends|crystal]] on Mustafar that was deeply connected to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] learned of the crystal and assembled an army to take Mustafar, resulting in a [[Devastation of Mustafar/Legends|battle]] in [[3996 BBY]]. During the battle, the crystal exploded with a force so intense it killed all Jedi and Sith in the battle and sent the planet out of its orbit around Jestefad, thus pulling Lefrani into the gravitic duel that began to tear Mustafar apart.

Centuries before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], a cataclysmic volcanic eruption destroyed most Mustafarian settlements, excluding [[Fralideja/Legends|Fralideja]]. Then, in [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]], the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] arrived on Mustafar, signing a treaty with the Mustafarians where the indigenous peoples would mine resources in exchange for technology. The [[Klegger Corporation]] was created by the Techno Union to mine the planet on their behalf, and the corporation constructed the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]].

By [[51 BBY/Legends|51 BBY]], the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] brought the [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to Mustafar to train him to be a [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]]. Early during the Clone Wars, [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, Separatist [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] tasked the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] [[EG-07]] to locate a [[Unidentified Mustafar superweapon|superweapon]] capable of releasing a deadly virus, which the droid eventually located on Mustafar. The Jedi learned of the weapon and [[Mission to Mustafar (superweapon)|dispatched]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]], who were able to destroy the weapon. Also during the war, Sidious hired the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] to kidnap Force-sensitive children and deliver them to a secret [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|facility]] on Mustafar. The Jedi Skywalker and Tano were able to locate the facility and rescue the children; however, Sidious's [[RO-Z67's model/Legends|nanny droids]] managed to destroy the facility, eliminating any evidence that could be traced back to Sidious.

Later in the Clone Wars, Maul [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|visited]] a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|fortress]] on Mustafar with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and the leader of [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], to recruit the crime syndicate into their [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]] criminal empire. After their offer was rejected, Opress beheaded the entire Black Sun council, and [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], now the leader of Black Sun, agreed to join. Shortly before the end of the war, [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] aligned with the Separatists discovered the wreckage of a [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] that had crashed on the planet ages ago, and within the wreckage they uncovered the droid [[HK-47]]. Finding the droid more advanced than anything they knew, [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] ordered the construction of a [[Neimoidian droid factory|factory]] to product an army of droids based off HK-47's technology. Though the facility was completed, the droids manufactured inside never saw operation.

As the war drew to a close, Sidious had General Grievous relocate the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] from [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to Mustafar to escape the eyes of the Republic. While they hid in the Klegger mining facility, Sidious dispatched his new apprentice, Darth Vader, who was secretly Anakin Skywalker turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], to execute the Council to bring an end to the Clone Wars. After Vader arrived and wiped out the entire Council, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]]—Vader's wife—and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]—Vader's former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]]—arrived on the planet. Feeling betrayed by his wife for her bringing Kenobi, though she was unaware Kenobi had stowed away on her ship, Vader [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force choked]] her until she was unconscious. Kenobi then approached, and the two [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|dueled]]. The duel resulted in the destruction of much of the mining facility, and in the end Kenobi arose victorious, with Vader being burned on the shores of a lava river with three of his [[Limb/Legends|limbs]] severed. Kenobi left with [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|Vader's lightsaber]], and Sidious arrived shortly after to rescue Vader from the riverbank.

After the end of the Clone Wars and the [[Declaration of a New Order|transition]] of the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] fugitive named [[Gizor Dellso]] came into possession of [[dataplan]]s for an experimental Imperial [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]]. Dellso spent years building up an [[Gizor Dellso's army|army]] and [[Gizor Dellso's navy|navy]]. The Empire uncovered Dellso's plot and dispatched the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]]. Imperial forces defeated the rebel navy and army, destroyed the dataplans, and killed Dellso, later destroying the Geonosian's droid factory from space.

In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], Mustafar's main continent was shifted by a massive earthquake, uncovering the ruins of the Jedi Enclave that had been buried for centuries. In the following [[Standard month/Legends|months]], [[Archaeology/Legends|archeologists]], [[Historian/Legends|historians]], [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]], and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] arrived on Mustafar to explore the ruins. Many visitors became corrupted by the dark side, which was still present in the ruins. This attracted users of the dark side to the planet. Over the next couple years, several regions were taken over by mercenary crews and dark side cults. In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], a group of spacers assisted the company [[Mensix Corp]], who itself had been imposed by the Empire to work for them, with repairs to mining facilities, negotiations with striking workers, and exploring the wreckage of the crashed ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser. In the cruiser, the spacers uncovered the [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] of HK-47. The droid tricked the group into helping him build a [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]], though the army was defeated in the [[Battle of Koseyet]], with HK-47 escaping.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Vartonis]], who had hired the [[Brotherhood Mortalis]] mercenaries, was close to discovering the largest shard of the broken Force crystal that had torn the planet apart centuries before. The [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] of the now-deceased Kenobi enlisted a group of Force-sensitive and non-Force-sensitive individuals to destroy the crystal before it fell into the hands of Vartonis. The group managed to access the [[Lair of the Crystal]] and defeated Vartonis and the Brotherhood Mortalis, destroying the remains of the crystal thereafter.

Following the defeat of the Galactic Empire at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a Force-sensitive [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] named [[X1]] attempted to build his own empire, dubbing himself a Sith Lord and constructing a [[X1's Fortress|fortress]] on Mustafar. X1 was hunted by fellow clone [[X2]], who had aligned with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]'s [[New Jedi Order]], and X2 eventually arrived on Mustafar with [[Grey Squadron]] to face X1. The latter clone dispatched [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] clones and Imperial [[Emperor's Royal Guard|Royal Guards]], but all were defeated by X2. Eventually, X2 leaped over X1's lightsaber as the latter used the Force to manipulate it, causing the dark side clone to be impaled and fall into the lava to his death.

==Description==
===Astronomy===
[[File:Jestefad.png|thumb|left|300px|Mustafar was locked in a gravitational battle between the gas giants Jestefad and Lefrani.]]
The young [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of Mustafar<ref name="db" /> was located in the [[Mustafar system/Legends|Mustafar system]]<ref name="TEA" /> of the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]],<ref name="teaoc" /> situated along the [[Tosste Spur/Legends|Tosste Spur]], an offshoot of the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] [[Hyperspace route|hyperspace lane]].<ref name="TEA" /> A tiny world<ref name="db" /> at only 4,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] in diameter, Mustafar orbited the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Priate/Legends|Priate]] in the third orbital position between the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giants]] [[Jestefad/Legends|Jestefad]] and [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]], though it had once orbited Jestefad itself.<ref name="TEA" /> With Mustafar orbiting closer to Jestefad and at a similar rate to both dueling planets,<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> the two giants were involved in a [[Gravity/Legends|gravimetric]] battle that, while tearing Mustafar apart, also prevented it from becoming a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of either celestial body.<ref name="db" /> A single rotation of the planet took 36 [[Standard hour/Legends|standard hours]], and the planet orbited its sun once every 412 [[Standard day/Legends|standard days]],<ref name="TEA" /> as well as the same number of [[Local day/Legends|local days]]. Mustafar had no moons of its own.<ref name="TCWCG" />

===Surface and climate===
{{Quote|The atmosphere there was quite corrosive.|C-3PO, to R2-D2|<ref name="Memory Loss">{{SWComicCite|7.13|Memory Loss}}</ref>}}
[[File:Lava_Rivers.png|thumb|right|300px|The dangerous volcanic landscape of Mustafar was covered in lava rivers]]
Mustafar was once a vital and green world orbiting Jestefad, though the relocation of Lefrani from its original orbit put the small world in the middle of a détente between the two larger bodies. Locked in an erratic orbit, the conflicting gravitational forces created in Mustafar a chaotic world<ref name="The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> with unstable geology.<ref name="FoC Prima">[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption Expansion'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> Mustafar's molten core was roiled by immense tidal stresses, resulting in a mountainous, cavernous crust covered in volcanoes,<ref name="TEA" /> jagged [[Obsidian/Legends|obsidian]] mountains, rivers and towering fountains of lava, and fire.<ref name="BF2 Prima">[[Star Wars Battlefront II: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront II'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> 35% of the the planet's surface was molten,<ref name="TCWCG" /> and the world experienced rains of ash.<ref name="FoC Prima" /> Unique and valuable mineral allotropes<ref name="db" /> such as [[Mirkanite/Legends|Mirkanite]]<ref name="CotF Lava Mining">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|cardname=Lava Mining}}</ref> permeated Mustafar's crust and mantle, and the world's lava, which contained mineral riches, was cool enough<ref name="db" />—800 [[Temperature/Legends|degrees]] Celsius (1,500 degrees Farenheit) due to the lower melting point of the unusual allotropes<ref name="CL" />—to be harvested by specialized equipment.<ref name="db" />

[[File:Lefranieclipse.png|thumb|left|300px|The gas giant Lefrani eclipses Mustafar's sun, Priate.]]
The skies above Mustafar were cloaked in choking black clouds of ash, smoke, [[Tephra/Legends|tephra]],<ref name="BF2 Prima" /> and bits of volcanic rock and glass; breathing was thus a chore for most [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoids]].<ref name="NEGAS" /> The world's turbulent [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] was rattled by cyclonic-force updrafts and thermal currents. Significant geological activity created a natural interference for scanners that kept the planet undetected by prying [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] for much of its history.<ref name="BF2 Prima" /> Due to being swamped by Jestefad's electromagnetic field,<ref name="CL" /> Mustafar also experienced frequent [[Magnetic storm/Legends|electromagnetic storms]]<ref name="The Complete Visual Dictionary" /> and wild [[Electrical storm/Legends|electrical storms]].<ref name="CL" /> Due to the planet's volcanic nature, versions of the phrase "until Mustafar freezes over" were commonly used in the galaxy,<ref name="Triple Zero">''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]''</ref> and the planet was used in comparison to explosions.<ref name="Invincible">''[[Legacy of the Force: Invincible]]''</ref>

===Flora and fauna===
[[File:LavaFlea-CVDNE.png|thumb|right|300px|The native Mustafarians used lava fleas as a mode of transport due to their reliability compared to machines.]]
Despite the geologic catastrophe on the planet's surface that [[Death/Legends|destroyed]] all non-subterranean life,<ref name="TEA" /> Mustafar was home to an array of species,<ref name="Biological Survey">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Friday%20Feature:%20Trials%20Of%20Obi-Wan%20Creatures&resource=features|text=Galactic Biological Survey Project – Mustafar}}</ref> thought the environment on Mustafar was the harshest known to have still allowed for the evolution of native lifeforms.<ref name="CL" /> The docile and intelligent<ref name="Biological Survey" /> [[Arthropod/Legends|arthropod]] [[Lava flea/Legends|lava fleas]] evolved underground and were domesticated by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]] as a mode of transport more reliable than technological alternatives.<ref name="DBFlea" /> The Mustafarians farmed fungus and [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentinet]] insects on the planet.<ref name="FactFile2">{{FactFile2013|2|MUS 1-2|Mustafar}}</ref> Despite local farming the planet did still import [[foodstuff]] and livestock from the planets such as [[Taanab]].<ref name="Enter the Unknown">''[[Enter the Unknown]]''</ref> The shape of the [[Kahel cave fungus/Legends|kahel cave fungus]] was the inspiration for Mustafarian architecture.<ref name="CL" />

The large, spiked, [[Diet/Legends|omnivorous]] [[Tulrus/Legends|tulrus]] inhabited the planet's northeastern regions and were known to be ill-tempered. They shared this region with the enormous [[Sher Kar/Legends|Sher Kars]], at least one of which dwelt in a lair. The predatory [[Blistmok/Legends|blistmoks]] traveled in packs of up to ten and favored the [[Burning Plains/Legends|Burning Plains]] and [[Smoking Forest/Legends|Smoking Forest]]. The [[Feline/Legends|feline]] [[Xandank/Legends|xandanks]] stalked and ambushed their prey and were observed in [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]], which was also home to the agile [[Lizard/Legends|lizards]] known as [[tanray]]s. The planet's central regions were home to the aggressive [[Jundak/Legends|jundaks]], which would ingest nearly anything. The vicious [[Kubaza beetle/Legends|kubaza beetles]] were hive-minded [[Insect/Legends|insects]] the lived all over Mustafar and survived off minerals in the lava, which occasionally caused them to explode when killed.<ref name="Biological Survey" /> Mustafar's lava flows were also home to the [[jawenko lava beast]]s, which could dwell within the lava itself. The creatures were capable of naturally refining [[xonolite]] into a liquid that, when injected into one's bloodstream, had a strangely euphoric effect. The drug was exported to [[Nkllon/Legends|Nkllon]] to be further refined into [[Nkllonian lava extract]].<ref name="CSWEjawenko">{{CSWECite|II|144|jawenko lava beast}}</ref>

==History==
===Early history===
{{Quote|It's obvious that civilizations have been present here for thousands of years. Strangely enough though, apart from the last few hundred years, there are no records at all of who was here or where they are now.|[[Epo Qetora]]|<ref name="SWG:Ahl">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|A history lesson|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
Once a lush green world,<ref name="LT">{{SonyCite|url=en_US/players/content.vm?page=Lost%20Treasure&resource=features|text=Lost Treasure}}</ref> Mustafar was home to a [[Jedi enclave (Mustafar)/Legends|Jedi Enclave]] established around [[5300 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> The enclave included several complexes of structures located in different areas of Mustafar's main continent<ref name="SWG:FotG">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Fate of the Galaxy|Mustafar}}</ref> and was used by the Jedi used to cultivate their abilities and train their students.<ref name="LT" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Chu-Gon Dar]], an individual whose mastery of [[Physical Force]] was unmatched, lived there at that time.<ref name="SWG:SoCGD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Symbols of Chu-Gon Dar|Mustafar}}</ref> His mastery of the Force allowed him to alter the molecular structure of the matter.<ref name="TEA" /> Dar created a unique [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] object known as the [[Chu-Gon Dar cube]] which was used to both channel and manipulate the physical Force to alter the physical properties of an item placed inside it.<ref name="SWG:SoCGD" />

[[File:Mustafar_edited.jpg|thumb|240px|left|The ruins of an ancient [[Jedi enclave (Mustafar)/Legends|Jedi Enclave]] on Mustafar]]
Around 1,300 years later,<ref name="TEA" /> the Jedi on Mustafar discovered a magnificent and colossal [[Lava crystal/Legends|crystal]] that was deeply [[Vergence/Legends|connected]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]].<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> However, during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] discovered the existence of the crystal and assembled an army to conquer Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> A climactic [[Devastation of Mustafar/Legends|battle]] took place on the planet in [[3996 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> As the Sith assaulted the planet, Jedi Masters channeled the Force through the crystal, allowing the Jedi on the battlefield to use more powers than ever while the Sith could barely use theirs. However, the Jedi Master engaged in the battle ignored that the crystal was cracking. Eventually, the crystal exploded and wiped out all of the Sith and Jedi in the battle. The explosion was so intense that it sent the planet itself out of its [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]].<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> The [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Lefrani/Legends|Lefrani]] was tugged out of its orbit and entered into a gravitational detente with the gas giant [[Jestefad/Legends|Jestefad]] and Mustafar was caught in the middle of these untenable gravitational forces. Immense tidal stresses roiled the planet's molten core, inundating the crust with lava and decimating all life at the surface.<ref name="TEA" /> The only survivor was Jedi Master [[Erg Krow]] who miraculously managed to use the power of the Force to protect himself from the cataclysm. Before dying, Krow used his last forces to put a protective Force shield around the shards of the crystal and make sure that no other [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] could ever discover it.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

After the battle, the planet Mustafar became a hellish volcanic world. The environmental hazards caused by this forced the Jedi to abandon their temples on the planet.<ref name="TEA" /> As a consequence of the battle, the ruins of the Jedi Enclave became a vergence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]]. Over the next millennia, the intense tectonic and volcanic activity of Mustafar shifted the surface of the planet. Most of the ruins of the Jedi Enclave eventually disappeared under the surface of the planet.<ref name="SWG:JK">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=conversation|Jo Keslev|Mustafar}}</ref> This caused all knowledge of Chu-Gon's cube to be lost.<ref name="SWG:SoCGD" />

Centuries later, some time after the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="TOR:TFE">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref> a [[Unidentified Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] crashed on the planet.<ref name="SWG:TDS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Downed Ship|Mustafar}}</ref> One of the cruiser's passengers was [[HK-47]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Trouble with HK-47|Mustafar}}</ref> an [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] that served the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Revan/Legends|Darth Revan]] during the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref> HK-47 survived the crash<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> but the volcanic activity of the planet buried the wreck under lava, rock and ash.<ref name="SWG:TDS" />

Near the end of the [[New Sith Wars]],<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> around [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> Mustafar became the home of the dark side organization known as the [[Blackguard (Mustafar)/Legends|Blackguard]]. Led by [[Vulta Daanat]], they settled the [[Southern Jedi Ruins]],<ref name="JATM" /> in the [[Smoking Forest]] region of Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:TSFM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Smoking Forest Markers|Mustafar}}</ref>

Over time, the ancient history of Mustafar was totally lost. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], historians were unable to reconstitute the history of the planet beyond the last few centuries,<ref name="SWG:Ahl" /> namely before the arrival of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and the beginning of the mining activity.<ref name="TEA" />

===Galactic Republic===
====A mining world====
{{Quote|Mustafar's unique nature makes it easy for us to extract ore, carbon, and aluminum. Those minerals just bubble right up to the surface. There is a fairly healthy market for these raw materials.|[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Chivos]]|<ref name="SWG:SftM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Supplies for the Miners|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
Mustafar was home to two variants of sentient [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarians]]—the [[Northern Mustafarian/Legends|northern Mustafarians]], who were tall and thin, and the [[southern Mustafarian]]s, who were short and squat.<ref name="NEGAS" /> Centuries before the Clone Wars, a cataclysmic eruption destroyed the majority of Mustafarian settlements except for [[Fralideja/Legends|Fralideja]].<ref name="CL" />

[[File:KleggerCorpMiningFacility.png|thumb|280px|right|The Klegger Corp Mining Facility]]
Mustafar became a major [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era,<ref name="TEA" /> when the Mustafarian explorer [[Jesl Berken]] discovered rich mineral deposits in the region that was later named [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]] after him.<ref name="SWG:TBFM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Berken's Flow Markers|Mustafar}}</ref> The Berken's Flow was for some times the richest source of natural resources in the galaxy.<ref name="SWG:BF">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=poi|Berken's Flow|Mustafar}}</ref> Mustafars mining prominance eventually fade but the Mustafarians continued to harvest the liquid resources and traded it with the few traders that ventured to Mustafar.<ref name="FactFile2" /> Then, in [[300 BBY/Legends|300 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> the Techno Union claimed Mustafar which would allow them to collect rare ores from its surface without the need for deep-bore mines. To this end the Techno Union signed a treaty with the native [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] which allowing them to mine the resources in exchange for advanced technology suited to the high temperatures on the planet.<ref name="DB Mustafarian">{{DB|species|mustafarian|Mustafarian}}</ref> The Techno Union created a mining company, the [[Klegger Corporation]], to mine the planet on its behalf.<ref name="FF">{{FactFile2013|2|MUS 1-2|Mustafar}}</ref> Klegger became the dominant mining company on the planet.<ref name="SWG:TCFM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Crystal Flats Markers|Mustafar}}</ref> The company built the [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]] that used electromagnetic and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] extraction technologies to collect liquid ores from the lava flow. The facility also processed lava manually collected by native Mustafarians and [[Mining droid/Legends|mining droids]].<ref name="CL" />

Sometime before [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], a [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|reclamation station]] on the planet owned by a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] named [[Cabra]] had been used to dispose of enemies and evidence. However by 54 BBY it had been made available to [[Damask Holdings/Legends|Damask Holdings]] which turned it into an accounting facility.<ref name="Darth Plagueis" />

====Training Maul====
Around 54 BBY, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] was given [[Darth Maul/Legends|Maul]], a newborn [[Dathomirian/Legends|Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] from a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] named [[Kycina]] while in the [[Blue Desert City]] on [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Kycina was seeking to save the boy from his fate of serving as a [[Nightbrothers/Legends|Nightbrother]] for Mother [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] but unbeknownst to her, she was giving him to a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]]. Sidious brought the boy to the Damask Holdings facility on Mustafar and left him in the care of [[Cleaning droid/Legends|custodial droids]]. Less than a year later, Sidious informed his master, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] about the child who instructed him to train the boy as a [[Sith assassin/Legends|Sith assassin]].<ref name="Darth Plagueis" /> 

[[File:SidiousMustafarLab-CotF.png|thumb|left|250px|Darth Sidious's Mustafar Facility]]
When Maul was three, in [[51 BBY/Legends|51 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> he was first allowed to see a chamber in the facility designed for Sidious. When Maul first entered the room he was transfixed by a large fish tank in the center of the room and did not notice Sidious. Sidious eventually demonstrated his use of the force by killing all by two of the fish in the orb. Maul asked his master if it was possible to learn the power he demonstrated which delighted Sidious who answered that it was possible with patience and proceeded to led Maul to be training room where he would receive his first personal instruction from Sidious. Over the next few months, Maul was by the droid in a new training room. One exercise taught Maul the vulnerabilities of nearly every native creature on Mustafar. Later during a sparing match with the droid, Maul first used the force to instinctively pull the droid's staff from the ground and into his hands. Much later, after returning from a training session off planet on [[Tosste/Legends|Tosste]] where Maul flinched as the sight of a [[Dinko (creature)|dinko]], Sidious filled Maul's room with dinko. It took Maul almost an hour to kill all of them, after which Sidious told Maul not to flinch again.<ref name="Wrath of Maul">''[[The Wrath of Darth Maul]]''</ref>

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> after the droid had broken several of Maul's ribs during a training exercise, Maul first learned the droids while it treated his wounds and it expressed some kindness for Maul. However when Sidious learned of the exchange he punished Maul by forcing him to repeat the exercise with broken ribs and the droid was then forced to break Maul's arm to stop the exercise. Maul later drew an image of the window from his former room on the wall of his room with his own blood to remember it. Upon learning of this Sidious had Maul brought to him and said that if he missed seeing Mustafar then that could be arranged before having Maul darted and taken outside and left with no provisions. Determined to survive, Maul tracked a group of Mustafarians, killed them and stole their supplies. Maul spent a total of seventeen days outside on Mustafar before returning to Sidious's facility. After being cleaned up and having some injuries healed, Sidious destroyed the droid saying he had no use for it any more and informed Maul that he would be taken off world to be trained on Orsis. Years later, Maul returned to Mustafar for fourteen days where he was put through a series of intense tests by Sidious, which he passed.<ref name="Wrath of Maul" /> Due to his time on Mustafar, Maul would considered it to be his homeworld.<ref name="EndGame">{{StoryCite|story=End Game|book=Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|bformatted=''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization, 2012 edition}}</ref>

===Clone Wars===
{{Quote|Master Kenobi, we have Miss Padmé on board. Yes, please. Please hurry. We should leave this dreadful place!|[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|<ref name="RotS" />}}
During the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]], the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Slick/Legends|Slick]] used a [[BARC speeder/Legends|BARC speeder]] that had the phrase "Send'em to Mustafar" written on it in [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]].<ref name="TCW Shadowed">''[[The Clone Wars: Shadowed]]''</ref>

====Rogue General====
[[File:UnidentifiedMustafarSuperweapon-ControlRoom-RepublicHeroes.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Ancient super weapon control room]]
During the early years of the war, the [[Cyborg/Legends|Cyborg]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] begun plotting to rebel against [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]]. To this end he employed a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] designated [[EG-07]] to locate an ancient [[Unidentified Mustafar superweapon|superweapon]] capable of releasing a deadly virus that he had learned about. EG-07 eventually located the weapon buried on Mustafar. By the time the Jedi Order had learned of Grievous's plans and tracked the weapon to Mustafar, Grievous had placed a [[Unidentified Mustafar battlesphere|battlesphere]] in the atmosphere of the planet and was planning to use the battlesphere's lasers to charge the weapon's long depleted power source. In order to stop Grievous, the Jedi [[Mission to Mustafar (superweapon)|dispatched]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to disrupt the sphere's three firing platforms. While working to disable the third platform, Skywalker and Tano were confronted by EG-07 who despite being defeated was able to delay the Jedi long enough for the weapon to be recharged. The Jedi proceeded to deploy Jedi Masters [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] to the planet and from there each worked their way down to the weapon where Windu was able to engage Grievous in the control room. Before Grievous was defeated by Windu and forced to retreat he activated the weapon however during the duel Yoda was able to reach and destroy the weapons core. Dooku later learned of Grievous's treachery but decided to forgive Grievous as his actions served as a distraction for the Jedi and allowed Dooku to progress is own plans.<ref name="Republic Heroes DS">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]'' {{C|Nintendo DS edition}}</ref>

====Future Lost====
[[File:CreepyNannySidious-CotF.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Sidious looking over Wee Dunn]]
Later in the war, [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] Palpatine, in his guise as Darth Sidious, tasked the [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] with kidnapping [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] children. Bane used his [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter/Legends|starfighter]], the ''[[Xanadu Blood/Legends|Xanadu Blood]]'', to delivered the children to Sidious' secret [[Darth Sidious's secret facility/Legends|facility]], where the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was planning to use the children to create an army of [[Spy/Legends|spies]] strong in the Force. The two of the stolen children, a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] named [[Roo-Roo Page]] and a [[Rodian]] named [[Wee Dunn]], were to be prepared for a surgical procedure meant to enhance them, as Sidious aimed at having an army of Sith spies to counteract the Jedi. The ''Xanadu Blood'' was later captured by the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and his Jedi [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] who were investigating the disappearances of the children. Skywalker and Padawan Tano used the ''Xanadu Blood''{{'s}} fuel logs to deduce that they might find a lead on Mustafar set out to [[Mission to Mustafar (Skywalker and Tano)/Legends|rescue]] them. As the Jedi arrived at the facility, Darth Sidious who was overseeing the enslavement procedure via a hologram, ordered the [[RO-Z67's model/Legends|nanny droids]] to evacuate the children and to turn off the facility's gravity supports to have it sink to the lava below thus destroying any evidence of the plot. The Jedi were able to find and rescue the younglings from the [[nanny droid/Legends|nanny droids]] before they were able to relocate the children. However the facility sank into the lava below it destroying any further evidence of Sidious's involvment.<ref name="CotF" />

While in the realm of [[Mortis/Legends|Mortis]] the [[Son/Legends|Son]], an embodyment of the dark side of the force lured Anakin Skywalker to the [[Well of the Dark Side/Legends|Well of the Dark Side]]. There the Son broke the rules of time and showed Skywalker his future fall to the dark side as well as his future battle on Mustafar.<ref name="GoM">{{TCW|Ghosts of Mortis}}</ref>

====Schemes in the shadows====
[[File:BlackSunfortressMustafar.png|thumb|right|250px|The Black Sun fortress]]
By the time of the Clone Wars, the criminal syndicate Black Sun,<ref name="Black Sun">{{SWE|groups|black-sun|Black Sun}}</ref> under the leadership of [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]]<ref name="Eminence" /> and a cabal of Falleen nobles, moved its headquarters to a [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|fortress]] on Mustafar. With the Jedi focused on the war and the Separatists Black Sun flourished during this time.<ref name="Black Sun" /> During 20 BBY, renegade Sith Lord Maul, his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]], and [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], the leader of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]] organization [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|traveled]] to the Black Sun fortress with the intention of recruiting them to their newly founded criminal empire, the [[Shadow Collective/Legends|Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Eminence" /> As their ship approached the world Maul remembered his childhood on Mustafar before pushing thoughts down to focus on the meeting with Black Sun.<ref name="Shadow Collective">''[[The Clone Wars: Darth Maul: Shadow Conspiracy]]''</ref> A Black Sun [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] named [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]],<ref name="Ziton Moj">{{SWE|characters|ziton-moj|Ziton Moj}}</ref> greeted the group when they arrived at the fortress and led the group before a council of the syndicates leaders. After negotiations with the leaders went sour, Savage beheaded all of the council with his [[Savage Opress's lightsaber|lightsaber]]. With the previous leaders dead, Moj became Black Sun's new leader and agreed to join the Shadow Collective, providing them with [[weapon]]s, [[soldier]]s, and supplies. Shadow Collective forces then began to load all of the supplies the Black Sun had at their disposal onto ships.<ref name="Eminence" />

====Building an army====
{{Quote|Viceroy Gunnary [sic] arrived today but informed us that the factory will have to remain offline for a while longer. He is awaiting word from Sideous [sic] before he can take the next step. The factory remains at the ready and if early estimates of its production capabilities are any indication, we will have a massive army of these new droids shortly after it is turned on.|A Separatist report|<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />}}
[[File:Wreckagemustafar.png|thumb|left|250px|The excavated Old Republic cruiser]]
During the Clone Wars, [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatists]] discovered the wreckage of the ancient [[Hammerhead-class cruiser|''Hammerhead''-class cruiser]] that had crashed on the planet eons ago.<ref name="SWG:ORC">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=loading|Old Republic Cruiser|Mustafar}}</ref> They excavated the wreckage<ref name="SWG:JK" /> and discovered the droid HK-47. The Neimoidian [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]] soon realized that HK-47's technology was superior than anything they knew. However, as they reactivated HK-47, the droid attacked the engineers and and killed many of them before one successfully placed a [[Restraining bolt/Legends|restraining bolt]] to stop it. Since they were unable to perform a memory wipe, the engineers transferred the memory and thought patterns of the droid into a sub-system of the crashed cruiser in order to study the technology of the droid safely. [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] then ordered the construction of a [[Neimoidian droid factory|droid factory]] on Mustafar in order to produce an army of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] based on HK-47's technology. The new droid models developed by the Separatists included new [[HK-series assassin droid|HK-series droids]], such as the [[HK-57]] and [[HK-67]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> and the larger [[Union Sentry Droid]]s.<ref name="SWG:USD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=loading|Union Sentry Droid|Mustafar}}</ref> Unfortunately for the Separatists, the construction of a droid factory was only achieved in the last days of the Clone Wars and the new battle droid models were never deployed. In the meantime, HK-47 remained conscious but stuck in the ruined system of the crashed Old Republic cruiser.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />

====End of the War====
{{Quote|After you have killed all the Jedi in the Temple, go to the Mustafar system. Wipe out Viceroy Gunray and the other Separatist leaders. Once more the Sith will rule the galaxy, and we shall have peace…|Darth Sidious to his new apprentice, Darth Vader|audio=Sidious-we-shall-have-peace.flac|<ref name="RotS" />}}
As the war's end drew nearer, Darth Sidious had [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] relocate the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] to a Klegger Corp Mining Facility on Mustafar under the leadership of Viceroy Nute Gunray.<ref name="RotS" /> Before the council departed, Gunray privately questioned the move to Grievous, noting that they had been told that [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] would be safer for them. However Grievous responded that Utapau was meant to be a temperately move and now with the newly finished defenses the confederacy installed on Mustafar, it was the most secure planet for them, stating that it could withstand the entire [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]]. Gunray accepted this reasoning stating that it better be safe due to the high construction cost of the base on Mustafar.<ref name="RotS Novelization">[[ Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref> At somepoint before before traveling to Mustafar with the Separatist Council, [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the Techno Union, visited the [[Power Mounds of the Elders]] on [[Skako/Legends|Skako]] where he was told he would meet his end on Mustafar.<ref name="Quest for the Sacred Eye">{{StoryCite|story=Wat Tambor and the Quest for the Sacred Eye of the Albino Cyclops|book=Star Wars: Visionaries}}</ref>

[[File:SeppyWarRoom-Ep3.png|thumb|right|300px|The Mustafarian mining complex that served as the Separatist Council's refuge at the war's end.]]
Shortly after the Separatist Council was relocated the Jedi Anakin Skywalker agreed to become Sidious's new Sith apprentice, [[Darth]] Vader, following the [[Showdown on Coruscant|failed arrest]] of Sidious by the Jedi and the death of Dooku at Skywalker's hands. Thus, Palpatine ordered the execution of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. This order commanded all the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to hunt and slaughter every Jedi in the galaxy, initiating the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]. After [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|attacking]] the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], Vader was tasked with traveling to Mustafar and [[Mission to Mustafar|eliminate]] the Separatist leaders. After informing his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Senator/Legends|Senator]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of his destination Vader traveled to Mustafar in his [[Darth Vader's green Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|interceptor]] alongside his [[Astromech droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]].<ref name="RotS" /> R2-D2 recorded this exchange and later displayed it as a [[hologram]] to Anakin and Padmé's son, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].<ref name="Swarm War">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref>

In the meantime, Order 66 was also executed on Mustafar. Clone troopers of [[Grey Squad]] attacked their commander, a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Mustafar)|Jedi Knight]] stationed on the planet during the war to keep watch on the Klegger Corp Mining Facility. The Jedi managed to escape the initial attack but was presumably killed some time later.<ref name="SWG:TJGD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Jedi's Guard Dog|Mustafar}}</ref>

An [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] before Vader arrived on Mustafar, Nute Gunray, under the direction of Darth Sidious, transmitted the deactivation code for the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] immediately, effectively ending the Clone Wars.<ref name="RotS Novelization" /> When Vader arrived at the Separatist facility's war room, he ordered R2-D2 to remain with his interceptor before he promptly slaughtered the Separatist Council, it's aides and guards.<ref name="RotS" /> While fighting in the facility, Vader was also force to destroy an armed [[Sheathipede-class transport shuttle/Legends|Sheathipede transport shuttle]] to prevent a member of the council from fleeing.<ref name="RotS Video Game">[[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' video game]]</ref> With the Jedi Order and Seperartist council being destroyed, Darth Sidious then took the opportunity to [[Declaration of a New Order |transform]] the Galactic Republic into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with himself as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], fulfilling the Sith [[Grand Plan/Legends|Grand Plan]] to seize control of the galaxy. Afterward, Vader informed Sidious that the council had been dealt and Sidious instructed Vader to have all droid units aboard Trade Federation ships shutdown.<ref name="RotS" />

====Duel on Mustafar====
{{Quote|Sometimes the Force has other plans for us, my son. Fortunately I arrived at Mustafar in time to save you.|Sidious to Vader|<ref name="Dark Lord">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref>}}
After being informed of her husband's alleged fall to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]], by his former master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], Amidala rushed to Mustafar to discover what she earlier could not believe. She arrived on the volcanic world shortly after the slaughter of the Separatist leaders, and Vader met her and embraced her outside the facility. She began pleading for Vader to turn away from the dark side when Kenobi himself came down from [[J-type star skiff|Padmé's ship]], having stowed-away against her knowledge, the enraged Vader [[Telekinesis/Legends#Force_Choke|Force choked]] his wife, leaving her unconscious.<ref name="RotS" />

[[File:Kenobi_Vader_Mustafar.png|thumb|left|220px|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|dueled]] to near-death on the planet.]]
Darth Vader then gave his old master and former friend an ultimatum: either he was with him or against him. Refusing to listen to Kenobi's attempts for him to renounce the dark side, Vader [[Duel on Mustafar/Legends|attempted]] to murder Kenobi by engaging him. The pair fought through the separatist facility causing damage to it and eventually causing the section they were fighting on to fall into the lava below. Forced to fight across the lava streams, Vader was fueled by hatred and, in his hubris, attacked without regard to his own limitations, and fell victim to Kenobi's [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|blade]] beside a lava river. As the Sith Lord lost himself to the dark side's corruption, his remaining limbs were severed and his entire body was incinerated by Mustafar's lava. Leaving his former pupil to die, Kenobi took Vader's [[Anakin Skywalker's second lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and departed the planet with C-3PO, R2-D2 and Amidala. Despite being medically health Amidala died shortly after giving birth to twins, Luke and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia]], having lost the will to live following Anakin's fall to the dark side.<ref name="RotS" />

Having sensed the battle between Vader and Kenobi, Sidious traveled to Mustafar aboard a [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|Theta-class T-2c shuttle ]] piloted by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kagi/Legends|Kagi]]<ref name="RotS" /> and escorted by two [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter]].<ref name="VWing Anniversary">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: 30th Anniversary Collection|pack=V-Wing Starfighter|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/TACvwingfighter.asp}}</ref> Sidious arrived in time to rescue Vader from the heat<ref name="RotS" /> and brought him back to Coruscant in a [[Medical capsule/Legends|medical capsule]],<ref name="Insider 95">{{InsiderCite|95|Star Wars Q&A|''Star Wars'' Q&A}}</ref> where he was rebuilt into the feared cyborg executor of the new [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]] at his [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center|Surgical Reconstruction Center]].<ref name="RotS" /> The scorching heat had left ragged scars on Vader's head and had melted away his ear drums beyond repair.<ref name="Dark Lord" /> Vader was treated with a special strain of [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] for server burns along with a set of drugs related to heavy metal contamination.<ref name="Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref>

As Vader adapted to the use of the new prosthetics he wondering if Sidious had deliberately engineered it as a prison to punish him for his failure to kill Kenobi. As Vader dwelt on the failure of Mustafar, Sidious wondered what he would have to do with him, even wondering if he would have to send him back to Mustafar. Even though Sidious did not for see Kenobi's defeat of Vader both him and Vader would later believe that if not for the events on Mustafar the two would have fought each other for control of the Empire. As time went by Vader's memories of his life as Anakin grew fainter and Vader would later consider Mustafar as the death of Anakin Skywalker and the birth of Darth Vader.<ref name="Dark Lord" /> By [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] had seen enough privileged information that led him to suspected that Skywalker had become Vader after the supposed death of Skywalker on Mustafar.<ref name="Death Star">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

===Imperial era===
====Aftermath of the Clone Wars====
{{Quote|We have been the biggest supplier of raw metals and minerals ever since Klegger Corp went bust just before the end of the Clone Wars. Something happened to their main plant...not sure what, but most of it ended up falling into the lava pool. They just never recovered from that incident and we took over.|[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Chivos]], about [[Mensix Corp]]|<ref name="SWG:SftM" />}}
[[File:MensixMiningFacility.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Mensix Mining Facility]]
The Klegger Corp Mining Facility was severely damaged during the confrontation between Darth Vader and Obi-Wan Kenobi, and a part of its structure collapsed into the surrounding lava.<ref name="RotS" /> Immediately after the formation of the Empire, the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] reported that an industrial accident on Mustafar drove the price of [[Dolovite]] to 760 credits per barrel.<ref name="HoloNet News">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref> Nevertheless, Klegger Corp never recovered from the damage of its main facility,<ref name="SWG:SftM" /> leaving the company, the most important on Mustafar, bankrupt.<ref name="SWG:MMF">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=loading|Mensix Mining Facility|Mustafar}}</ref> After the destruction of the Separatist Council, the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] was [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialized]] and Mustafar was largely forgotten.<ref name="db" /> The Mustafarians quickly took over the mining operations of the Techno Union.<ref name="FF" /> [[Milo Mensix]], a local corporation executive, salvaged the assets and the staff of Klegger Corp, preventing the mining business from falling apart.<ref name="SWG:TDS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Downed Ship|Mustafar}}</ref> [[Mensix Corp]] eventually became the largest mining corporation on the planet.<ref name="SWG:MMF" /> The [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining facility]] was built shortly after the end of the Clone Wars,<ref name="SWG:TMFM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Mining Field Markers|Mustafar}}</ref> in the neighborhood of the ruins of the Klegger Corp Mining Facility.<ref name="Mustafar Diorama">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Mustafar Diorama}}</ref>

While aboard the [[Sundered Heart/Legends|''Sundered Heart'']], C-3PO commented on their recent experiences on Mustafar and its corrosive atmosphere to R2-D2 shortly before C-3PO was forced to have a [[Memory wipe/Legends|memory wipe]] performed.<ref name="Memory Loss" /> The events on Mustafar haunted Obi-Wan who saw Anakin's fall as his failure.<ref name="Lone Wolf">{{StoryCite|story=Lone Wolf: A Tale of Obi-Wan and Luke|book=SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story}}</ref> Obi-Wan would continue to reflect and relived his experiences on Mustafar, even tasting ash in his mouth and fire in his lungs,<ref name="Last One Standing">{{StoryCite|story=The Last One Standing|book=Legacy of the Jedi/Secrets of the Jedi omnibus|text=''Legacy of the Jedi/Secrets of the Jedi'' omnibus}}</ref> in 19 BBY<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> while he was tracking down a group of [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] on [[Tatooine]] in order to recover a number of [[Moisture vaporator/Legends|moisture vaporators]] for the [[Lars homestead/Legends|Lars homestead]].<ref name="Last One Standing" /> Although Obi-Wan believed that he had killed Vader on Mustafar, he later discovered that Vader survived after hearing a [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] report about a [[Battle of Kashyyyk (19 BBY)|battle]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] where Vader killed a number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] survivors.<ref name="Dark Lord" /> The revelation of Vader's survival would continue to weigh on Kenobi, wondering if leaving Vader to die ultimately deepened his fall to the dark side and later telling the [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] of this master [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] that he should have made sure Vader was dead.<ref name="Life and Legend">''[[The Life and Legend of Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''</ref>

After becoming part of the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]], former Jedi [[Ferus Olin]] begun investigating Vader's origins eventually getting access to information from a break-in at the surgical reconstruction center. Olin forward the data to [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Amie Antin]], who noticed the shipments of an emergency shipment of burn specific bacta and detoxification drugs related to treating heavy metal exposure. One of which was only used to treat a specific allotrope that can only survive in cooler lava, like that found on Mustafar.<ref name="Master of Deception" />

Following the funeral of Amidala, her head of security [[Gregar Typho/Legends|Gregar Typho]] during her time as Senator was motivated to find the truth behind her death and opened an investigation as he always held an unrequited love for her. Over the next year, Typho searched for records regarding the events on Mustafar. He eventually obtained the official records detailing Skywalker's death on Mustafar, however he noticed that the record did not list the cause of death which led him to conclude that it was not a normal death and eventually speculated that Vader had been responsible for the death. Typho later paid 5000 credits to [[Boulad]], an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], who had obtained additional travel records that included Darth Sidious's journey to Mustafar, which reinforced Typho's belief that Vader had travelled to Mustafar and killed both Padme and Skywalker (not knowing Vader was actually Skywalker himself). Typho eventually confronted Vader who confirmed that he indeed killed both Padme and Skywalker before killing Typho when he attempted to fight Vader.<ref name="Coruscant Nights II">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref>

====Gizor Dellso's rebellion====
{{Quote|Although the Clone Wars were over, some people never seem to get the message. The worst case of denial was Gizor Delso, a Geonosian Separatist who'd somehow escaped Lord Vader's efforts to wipe out the remnants of the CIS. Lord Vader tracked him to Mustafar, and brought us in to finish the job.|[[Retired clone trooper]]|audio=GizorDellso1.flac|<ref name="bf2" />}}
Following the end of the Clone Wars a [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]] fugitive named [[Gizor Dellso]], who had [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|refused to surrender]] at the end of the war, came into possession of stolen [[dataplan]]s for an experimental Imperial starfighter. In order to safely plan his next movies, he made his way to to Mustafar and reactivated a hidden [[Techno Union droid factory/Legends|droid factory]]. There he spent years building up his forces including a [[Gizor Dellso's army|army of battle droids]] and a [[Gizor Dellso's navy|fleet of ships]].<ref name="bf2" />

[[File:BF_Mustafar_5.jpg|thumb|left|230px|The 501st Legion assaulted the Klegger Corp Mining Facility.]]
The Empire discovered Dellso's activities on Mustafar<ref name="bf2" /> sometime between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]],<ref name="Battlefront II date">Based on combined information from multiple sources, the events of ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'' [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|mission to Mustafar]] takes place between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]:
*''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].
*''Star Wars: Battlefront II'' specifies that "[[Standard year/Legends|years]]" passed between the formation of the Empire and the mission to Mustafar, which places the earliest date to 17 BBY. 
*''Star Wars: Battlefront II'' also places the mission to Mustafar before the [[Kamino uprising]] which ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates to [[12 BBY/Legends|12 BBY]].
Thus the Mustafar battle must therefore take place between [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] and 12 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]</ref> for which the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] was dispatched by Lord Vader to eliminate Dellso. The [[Battle of Mustafar (Imperial Period)|501's mission]] began in orbit over Mustafar, where Dellso's fleet engaged the Imperials. During the battle, the 501st repelled the droids that had boarded their [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], destroyed a number of [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] and crippled a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class carrier/destroyer]].<ref name="bf2" />

The 501st then landed on the planet and stormed the mining facility near his droid factory in other to destroy the [[Confederate infantry prototype|schematics]] for a new type of battle droid. After the legion's troopers successfully destroyed the plans, Dellso joined the battle personally. Despite being accompanied by other armed Geonosians and battle droids, Dellso was eventually killed in battle. After which the Empire destroyed the Klegger Corp mining facility and Dellso's droid factory [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|from space]].<ref name="bf2" />

===Galactic Civil War===
====Operation Skyhook====
{{Quote|Set a course for Mustafar. Infiltrate the factory and look for weak spots in the installation. Help us find a way to stop their operation.|[[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], to [[Rianna Saren]]|<ref name="Lethal Alliance" />}}
Shortly before the [[Death Star plans/Legends|Death Star plans]] were [[Operation Skyhook|stolen]], the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] hired [[Rianna Saren]], a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]], to investigate a research ship on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] that was seized by a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] named [[Slak Sagar]] that the Alliance had connected with a secret Imperial project. After making her way through the ship to the communication center, Saren overheard a conversation between the Sagar and [[Zarien Kheev]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Slavery|slaver]] communicating via [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]]. During the conversation they discussed shutting down their project on the ship due to Saren's inflation as well as a final shipment of a drug to Mustafar. Saren later relayed the contents of the conversation to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] who pieced together that the drug was being used on slaves working to produce [[Mirkanite/Legends|Mirkanite]] on Mustafar. Saren proceeded to volunteer to [[Mission to Mustafar (Rianna Saren)|investigate]] the [[Mirkanite Mining Facility/Legends|facility]] on Mustafar for the Alliance hoping to catch up with Kheev who had previously owned and mutilated Saren.<ref name="Lethal Alliance" />

[[File:Star_wars_lethal_alliance_mustafar.jpg|thumb|right|280px|Rebel Alliance operative Rianna Saren raided an Imperial mining facility.]]
After landing on Mustafar, Saren made her way to the facility while gliding over lava rivers using her hovering droid companion [[Z-58-0|Zeeo]]. Once Saren reached the edge of the facility she proceeded on foot past a number of Stromtroopers. Rianna eventually made her way to a control room where Zeeo discovered that Kheev had left for Tatooine. Rianna vowed to follow Kheev to Tatooine after the mission to get her vengeance. Rianna then made her way to the main drilling shaft where she and Zeeo sabotaged three vents which caused lava rise and destroy the facility. After making it back to her ship she fought through a number of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE fighters]] before being able to jump to [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]. After her mission to Mustafar, Saren began utilized a martial arts move called the [[Winds of Mustafar]]. When Saren caught up Kheev in his compound on Tatooine, Kheev expressed his anger over the destruction of the Mustafar facility.<ref name="Lethal Alliance" />

====The treat of the Conqueror====
{{Quote|This was a small, uninhabited planetoid in the Mustafar system. Still, the power of this weapon is incredible.|[[Col Serra]]|<ref name="TotC">{{SWGTCG|set=Threat of the Conqueror|scenario=Light Side scenario campaign}}</ref>}}
Around [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{StarWarsGalaxiesDate}}</ref> the Galactic Empire completed the construction of the [[Conqueror (superlaser)|''Conqueror'']], an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] armed with a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]]. As a final test, the ''Conqueror'' traveled to the Mustafar system where the ship successfully destroyed a [[Unidentified Mustafar system planetoid|planetoid]] with its superlaser. In the meantime, a group of [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Alliance Special Forces]], [[Renegade Squadron/Legends|Renegade Squadron]], discovered the existence of the ship during a [[Mission to Naboo (Renegade Squadron)|mission]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Renegade Squadron swiftly headed to the Mustafar system in order to [[Mission to Mustafar (Renegade Squadron)|destroy the ship]]. The objective was to infiltrate one of the supply shuttles that traveled regularly from the surface of Mustafar to the ''Conqueror''. On Mustafar, Renegade Squadron was attacked by the [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Director]] [[Ysanne Isard]] and a squad of Blackguard elite minions. The Rebels defeated their enemies and finally stole a shuttle. They then boarded the ''Conqueror'' where they were soon discovered by Imperial troops. After a series of firefights, including with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Victor Strang]] and his [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commandos]], the Alliance Special Forces managed to plant detonation charges in the ship's reactor core. Darth Vader later attacked the Rebels in the docking bay but Renegade Squadron succeeded in escaping the Star Destroyer before it exploded. Darth Vader also managed to escape the detonation of the ''Conqueror'' in his [[Darth Vader's TIE Advanced/Legends|TIE Advanced]].<ref name="TotC" />

====The rediscovery of Mustafar====
{{Quote|Mustafar has some pretty rich history, right? Jedi and the like battling it out there. I figure there's got to be plenty of old artifacts there just waiting to be dug up.|A [[Tansarii Point Station/Legends|Tansarii Point Station]] guard|<ref name="SWG:TPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref>}}
In [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a massive earthquake shifted the surface of Mustafar's main continent. The tremor uncovered several series of ruins of the Jedi Enclave that were buried under Mustafar's surface for centuries. This unexpected event attracted attention of offworlders to the remote planet.<ref name="SWG:TSFM" /> In the next months, numerous [[Archaeology/Legends|archeologists]]<ref name="SWG:SoCGD" /><ref name="SWG:AAP" /> and [[Historian/Legends|historians]],<ref name="SWG:Ahl" /><ref name="SWG:UtS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Unlocking the Secrets|Mustafar}}</ref> as wells as [[Treasure hunting/Legends|treasure hunters]]<ref name="SWG:AAP" /><ref name="SWG:Tcs">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The cursed shard|Mustafar}}</ref> and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]]<ref name="SWG:UtS" /><ref name="SWG:FotG" /> arrived on the planet to explore the ruins.<ref name="SWG:TSFM" /> Around the same time, Mustafar was advertised as a vacation destination where visitors could ride lava fleas and float down a river of lava on heat shielded repulsorlist platforms.<ref name="MTA">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Mustafar Travel Advertisement|swglink=Mustafar Travel.JPG}}</ref>

[[File:Chu-Gon_Dar_Ruins.jpg|thumb|left|280px|The rediscovered ruins of the Jedi Enclave.]]
Alarmingly, many of the offworlders who explored the Jedi ruins were corrupted by the power of the dark side of the Force, still strongly present in the ruins millennia after the devastation of Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:TSFM" /> Also, other individuals were corrupted by [[Force artifact/Legends|Force artifacts]] found in the ruins.<ref name="SWG:Tcs" /><ref name="SWG:Bags">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Being a good samaritan|Mustafar}}</ref> Thus, [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark side adepts]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] also got interested by Mustafer and landed on the planet.<ref name="SWG:FotG" /><ref name="SWG:TSS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Serpent Shard|Mustafar}}</ref>

By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{StarWarsGalaxiesDate}}</ref> the work of the historians and archeologists arrived on Mustafar had well progressed. The historian [[Epo Qetora]] had discovered in an [[Old Research Facility|Old Republic research facility]] information that allowed him to reconstruct the history of the battle that caused the devastation of Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:Ahl" /> In addition, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Ithes Olok]] excavated in the Jedi Temple ruins a hidden underground storage chamber filled with hundreds of Chu-Gon Dar cube, similar to the device originally created by the Jedi Master Chu-Gon Dar millennia before.<ref name="SWG:SoCGD" /> However, the exploration of the Jedi ruins by scholars was significantly obstructed by various criminals and dark side adepts. The [[northern Jedi Ruins]] were overran by a group of [[Coyn]] mercenaries known as the [[Razor Runners]].<ref name="SWG:UtS" /> The [[southern Jedi Ruins]] was contested by [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Narl]]'s [[Treasure Hunters|mercenary crew]] and the Dark Jedi of the Blackguard.<ref name="SWG:AAP" /> In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> various groups of spacers were hired to deal with those problems. The historian [[Pletus Croix]] recruited spacers who defeated [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Hal Razor]] and the Razor Runners in the northern Jedi Ruins.<ref name="SWG:UtS" /> Elsewhere, Doctor [[Mi Fon Lu]] hired a group of spacers who killed many Blackguard cultists and their leader, [[San'sii]] the Kursk, in the southern Jedi ruins.<ref name="SWG:AAP" />

[[File:Storm_Lord.jpg|thumb|right|220px|The Storm Lord, a professor turned into a powerful Dark Jedi by the presence of the dark side in the Jedi ruins.]]
The situation was more confusing in the eastern [[Jedi Ruins]]. These ruins had become the stronghold of a dark side cult led by an individual known as the [[Storm Lord]]. In fact, the Storm Lord and his adepts were originally [[Professor/Legends|Professor]] [[Storm Lord|Namdaot]] and his team of archeologists who were all corrupted by the power of the dark side of the Force while searching the ruins.<ref name="SWG:SotSL">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Sickness of the Storm Lord|Mustafar}}</ref> In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> two [[Journalist/Legends|journalists]] for the ''[[Corellia Times|Corellian Times]]'', [[Jural]] and [[Talper]], arrived on the planet to cover Professor Namdaot's excavation of the ruins. However, they were attacked by the Storm Lord cultists who attempted to turn them into new adepts. Both escaped but Talper soon became deathly ill, apparently due to one of the Storm Lord's dark side [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. A band of spacers who visited the area later found Jural and a dying Talper. The desperate Jural convinced the adventurers to attack the dark side cultists to save his brother. The spacers assaulted the ruins and slayed many Storm Lord zealots. Finally, the Storm Lord himself was also killed, releasing Talper from his affliction.<ref name="SWG:SotSL" />

====The trouble with HK-47====
{{Quote|I...we need your help in a most desperate way. The client we are working for is the Empire. They came to us with a very generous offer last year, but they keep altering the deal. Always demanding more...faster. We cannot keep up anymore.|[[Milo Mensix]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:TDS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Downed Ship|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
As the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] escalated after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Galactic Empire needed more natural resources.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], Darth Vader directly contacted Milo Mensix<ref name="ToOWPoI">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Trials%20of%20Obi-Wan%20Points%20of%20Interest|text=Trials of Obi-Wan Points of Interest}}</ref> and imposed Mensix Corp. to work for the Empire. Mensix accepted but the Empire requested more that what the company could produce. As the Empire threatened to [[Imperialization/Legends|nationalise]] Mensix Corp, Milo Mensix pushed his staff and machinery to work over capacity.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> By [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{StarWarsGalaxiesDate}}</ref> the Mensix Mining Facility was solicited to run at close to 200 percent capacity, causing damage to the equipment.<ref name="SWG:RAF">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Replace Air Filters|Mustafar}}</ref> Finally, a wide strike of the mining crews erupted, making the situation even more desperate for the Milo Mensix.<ref name="SWG:TS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Strike|Mustafar}}</ref> Fortunately, the company was able to hire a band of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who were eager to help.<ref name="SWG:SftM">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Supplies for the Miners|Mustafar}}</ref> The spacers performed several tasks to deal with several immediate problems, including repairs of the mining facility.<ref name="SWG:SftM" /><ref name="SWG:RAF" /><ref name="SWG:SoD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Salvage or Die|Mustafar}}</ref> They also negotiated with the miners on strike.<ref name="SWG:TS" />

[[File:HK47army-SWGMB.jpg|thumb|left|300px|HK-47's droid army]]
Later, the Milo Mensix tasked the spacer with exploring the wreckage of an Old Republic cruiser in order to find ancient lost technologies that could be used to improve his mining technology.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> In the crashed ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser, the spacers discovered the [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]]<ref name="SWG:TTotA">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Transfer of the AI|Mustafar}}</ref> of the assassin droid HK-47, still confined in a wrecked computer since the Clone Wars.<ref name="SWG:TTwH">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Trouble with HK-47|Mustafar}}</ref> HK-47 tricked the spacers into helping him to escape the ship's computer. The droid claimed that he could help Mensix Corp to find the wanted technology if they transferred his memory to the computers of an old [[Old Research Facility|research facility]],<ref name="SWG:TTotA" /> and then to an abandoned [[Neimoidian droid factory|Separatist droid factory]], both located in the [[Berken's Flow/Legends|Berken's Flow]] on Mustafar. The spacers followed HK-47's instructions<ref name="SWG:WPWT">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Wrong Place, Wrong Time|Mustafar}}</ref> but they eventually realized that they inadvertently allowed HK-47 to begin the production of a large [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]]. Furious at having been stuck in a crashed ship for two decades, the assassin droid wanted to take revenge by destroying all [[Species/Legends|organics]] on the planet.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> 
[[File:Miners1.jpg|thumb|right|275px|The Battle of Koseyet.]]
The spacers returned to the Mensix Mining facility as quickly as possible to warn Milo Mensix that the mining complex was the main target of HK-47's droid army. The Mustafarians had limited defensive capabilities but the miners fought heroically the battle droids and, thanks to the intervention of a large group of spacers hired by Milo Mensix, they finally [[Battle of Koseyet|defeated]] the droid army at the [[Koseyet Mining Camp]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> Eventually, HK-47 and the remnants of his army were defeated by the spacers in an epic [[Battle in a volcano crater|battle]] in a volcano crater. Nevertheless, HK-47 survived the battle and escaped. After the conclusion of HK-47's droid revolution, Mensix Corp took control of the old Separatist droid factory with the intention to sell the resources stockpiled there to the Empire, and therefore prevent the Empire to interfere with the activities of the company.<ref name="SWG:DH">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Destroy HK-47|Mustafar}}</ref>

====The trials of Obi-Wan====
{{Quote|Who I am is not of any importance. What I need help with, on the other hand, may affect the future of the entire galaxy.|Obi-Wan Kenobi|<ref name="SWG:FotG" />}}
[[File:SpiritOfKenobi_-_SWG_TCG.jpg|thumb|left|220px|Obi-Wan Kenobi's eternal spirit returned to Mustafar to correct a disturbance in the Force.]]
At the end of the battle that devastated Mustafar,<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> in 3996 BBY,<ref name="TEA" /> the powerful Force crystal used by the Jedi against the Sith exploded and wiped out life on the planet. Just before dying, Jedi Master Erg Krow created a shield of Force to hide the shards of the crystal forever. However, the power of the Force shield diminished over the next thousand years and finally vanished during the Galactic Civil War.<ref name="SWG:FotG" /> The situation caused a great [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance in the Force]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Champions of the Force|cardname=Fate of the Galaxy}}</ref> All the dark side adepts on the planet sensed the presence of the Crystal and began to search for this considerable source of power. The most dangerous of them was [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Vartonis]], a powerful Dark Jedi who had hired the [[Brotherhood Mortalis]] mercenary unit to support him in his quest.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

[[File:Duel_with_Vartonis.jpg|thumb|right|280px|A follower of Obi-Wan Kenobi duels Lord Vartonis near the shard of the crystal.]]
In 1 ABY,<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> Vartonis was dangerously close to found the largest shard of the broken Force crystal. This alarming situation drew the [[Force ghost/Legends|Force ghost]] Obi-Wan Kenobi to the planet. Kenobi's spirit enlisted a group of would-be Jedi and non-Force sensitive spacers to help him to destroy the crystal before it fell into the hands of evil, and therefore correct the imbalance in the Force. [[Mission on Mustafar|Guided]] on their path by the spectral form of Kenobi, the adventurers acquired a small shard of the crystal from a crazed Mustafarian hermit. Thanks to this shard, that was slightly destroying the sanity of the spacers, the group got access to the [[Lair of the Crystal]], beneath the [[Temple Ruins (Mustafar)|Jedi Temple ruins]]. There, they confronted Lord Vartonis and the Brotherhood Mortalis that just arrived to claim the crystal. However, the Dark Jedi was too powerful and the adventurers were obliged to use the power of the crystal to fight him. Eventually, the adventurers defeated Vartonis and his mercenaries. Then, following the advice of Obi-Wan's spirit, they destroyed the Force crystal once for all, finally removing the influence of the dark side on Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:FotG" />

====Zann Consortium's corruption====
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption}}
After escaping imprisonment on [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] prior to the Battle of Yavin, the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Tyber Zann]] rebuilt his criminal organization known as the [[Zann Consortium/Legends|Zann Consortium]]. Following the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] the Consortium used a [[defiler]] to bribe officials on Mustafar into aiding him in his pursuits. Corrupted officials alerted Zann of Imperial fleet movements in the system while Mustafarian [[Militia/Legends|militias]] tolerated the presence of Consortium criminals on the planet.<ref name="Forces of Corruption">''[[Star Wars: Empire at War: Forces of Corruption]]''</ref>
